subject: general
question:
In the following Venn diagram, the rectangle represents engineers, the circle represents the people who live in urban areas and the triangle represents the people who are in government jobs. Which letter represents engineers who live in urban areas and are in government jobs?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd58b67aafcde69f819194b104daad7816bf645ccda8efbd36c4565b4f1084f0.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e01302461d4ab58f7b7b97affd401962004fd630dca0f5005973e5865de6f02.png] 

The shaded region represents the engineers who live in urban areas and are in government jobs.

So, the engineers who live in urban areas and are in government jobs = 'C'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
